title: Text-mining CURE research project with GenAI
summary: Students complete a four-week course-based undergraduate research experience in text mining. After prompt-engineering guidance, they use ChatGPT for literature review, coding and technical problems, and concept clarification while producing a code repository, research paper, and peer reviews.

sources.title: Work-in-Progress: Course-based Undergraduate Research Experience (CURE) with Generative AI in a Computer Science Course
sources.evidence_quote: Embedded in the course is a course-based research experience over four weeks, which involves a research overview, research problem and literature review, research design and methods, and research paper construction.

assessment.summary: Conduct a four-week text-mining research project with GenAI support and communicate the work in code, a paper, and peer reviews.
student_actions: Define a research problem and review literature.
Design and conduct a text-mining study.
Use ChatGPT for literature, coding, technical, and conceptual support.
Write a research paper and maintain a code repository.
Review up to three classmates' papers.

student_role.description: Students use ChatGPT after instruction in prompting and critical review of factual output.
